name: ToolCallCard
description: One call an agent made: what it ran, where it got to, and — when the header is opened — what went in and what came back.

props.name: name
props.description: The tool's name, as the model called it. It is what the header reads.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the name: what this call is for, in the app's own words.

props.name: input
props.description: The arguments. A string is shown as it stands, anything else as the JSON a reader can check.

props.name: output
props.description: What came back, shown the same way.

props.name: error
props.description: What went wrong, shown in place of the output.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled: whether the body is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it starts open. Default `false` — a transcript of tool calls is a list, not a wall of JSON.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the header is pressed, with the body's new state.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether the body can be opened at all. Default `true`; `false` leaves the header a plain row.

props.name: inputLabel
props.description: The word above the arguments. Default `Input`.

props.name: outputLabel
props.description: The word above what came back. Default `Output`.

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: The word above what went wrong. Default `Error`.

props.name: valueLimit
props.description: How much of a value is shown before it is cut. Default `AgentUtils.VALUE_LIMIT` (20,000 characters).

props.name: children
props.description: Anything else that belongs in the body, under the values.

keyboard.action: Focuses the header, and again leaves it. Nothing inside a closed body is reachable.
Opens the body, or closes it.

a11y: The header is a real `<button>` carrying `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` when there is a body to open, and a plain row when there is not — a control that discloses nothing is a control nobody wants to land on.
`aria-busy` while the call is running, so a reader is told the card is not finished rather than reading a half-written result as the answer.
The card announces nothing itself. The transcript it is rendered into is what does that, and a live region inserted together with its content is not reliably announced.
